description: Large family accommodation of 100 square meters with terrace, quiet and sunny in the district of Ménilmontant, in the heart of authentic and popular Paris. Located on the 2nd floor with elevator, in a quiet and wooded family residence. At the foot of Belleville Park, 100 meters from the Couronnes metro station, and a 10-minute walk from the Père-Lachaise cemetery.
